scope: Readonly exact source-role review; no repository edits or compilation

stock_rules.fact: ek_sizeof explicitly bypasses function-only/default-argument/template restriction for GNU statement expression.
Unevaluated context can suppress source sequence generation, but actual compound block still scanned and passed to record_file_scope_statement_expr.
If block is allocated in file-scope region, an iek_statement entry is prepended to il_header.file_scope_statements. Actual list order is reverse insertion, not execution schedule.
Header list is for file-scope statements reachable from other IL entries, not a scheduled TU execution list.
Statement expression with variably modified result type is explicitly rejected; the proposed int result is fixed and sizeof operand unevaluated.

backend_issue.fact: Header list generic entity traversal inherits default7001 or7003. Statement adapter calls promote_execution on existing node, so this reachability visit can upgrade an otherwise metadata-only unevaluated block and its children.

recommendation: Visit only this header list with saved/restored default metadata7002, preserving existing active execution role through Store semantic_role/promote rules. Do not demote nodes reached from genuine execution; do not modify global default for all header roots. No schema addition required.
validation: Genuine file_scope_statement root must exist, exported block/subtree of sizeof remainsmetadata, sizeof initializer exact integer sizeof(int), no synthetic execution link from TU root. Ordinary control routine call still executable exactlyonce. Check native/source profile retention as available; do not guess when EDG removes something.
limits: Source review establishes parser path and role bug risk, not successful live fixture activation. Native lane owns probe.
No optional source-coordinate work or semantic reconstruction.
